arxiv-2509-14011.description: Abstract Hadronization, a non-perturbative process, cannot be calculated from first principles. These fragmentation functions are non-perturbative quantities whose determination relies entirely on experimental data. However, higher-twist fragmentation functions present significant challenges for their determination due to power suppression.

pmc-12677621.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Herein, a magnetic micromotor‐functionalized DNA‐array hunter (MMDA hunter) is developed by integrating enzyme‐propelled micromotors, magnetic nanoparticles, and nucleic acid aptamers into distinct functional partitions of a DNA tile self‐assembly structure.
